newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 13-wk T-bill auction for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 13-wk T-bill auction for Wed.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of 13-week treasury bills on July 16, the central bank (NBS) said in a statement.
The ministry rejected all bids in the last auction of 13-week T-bills on May 14, after the average yield hit 14.84 percent in the previous auction of T-bills with the same maturity on April 9.
In the last Finance Ministry T-bill auction, a tranche of five-week paper, average yield was 16.048 percent.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer at state securities auctions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.790 billion crowns as of July 8, 1997, from 7.177 billion crowns in the January-May period of 1997.
